Naim Classical Naim Audio (UK). Curated, mainstream repertoire. FLAC 16/44.1

SECTOR Nota Russian. 24-bit container; depth of source unknown. FLAC 24/44.1

KDFC San Francisco, Classical California. 96 kbps is all StreamTheWorld serves now. AAC 96/44.1
KUSC Los Angeles, KDFC's sister station. AAC 96/44.1
Classical KING FM Seattle. Best-sounding US stream in the list. AAC 256/44.1
ABC Classic Australia (Sydney feed), HLS. Daytime there is night here. AAC 256/44.1

WDR 3 Cologne. Classical by day, jazz and new music late. MP3 256/48
hr2-kultur Frankfurt. hr-Sinfonieorchester concerts. MP3 256/48
SWR Kultur Stuttgart and Baden-Baden; the old SWR2. MP3 256/48

rbbKultur Berlin. MP3 192/48

WQXR New York. MP3 128/48
WFMT Chicago. Fine presenters. MP3 128/48

Radio Swiss Classic Swiss, no talk, no news. MP3 128/48
Radio Classique Paris, commercial; talk in the mornings. MP3 128/48
